description: This file defines several 'simple-method' elements used for human resources operations such as creating internal organizations, removing positions, removing internal organizations, and creating public holidays within an enterprise system. These methods involve service calls, database entity manipulations, and input validation.

methods.name: createInternalOrg
methods.description: Establishes an internal organization relationship between parties, setting appropriate relationship and role types, and calls the 'createPartyRelationship' service.

methods.name: removeEmlpPosition
methods.description: Removes an employee position fulfillment and the position itself based on provided parameters.

methods.name: removeInternalOrg
methods.description: Deletes an internal organization relationship between parties.

methods.name: createPublicHoliday
methods.description: Creates a public holiday work effort entry, validating input parameters and setting the holiday duration.
